1313: function updateBattleCamera(snap=false,frameDt=null){
1314:   if(!battleStarted||typeof camera==='undefined')return;
1315:   const now=performance.now(),dt=Math.max(1/240,Math.min(.05,Number.isFinite(frameDt)?frameDt:(now-cameraLastUpdate)/1000||1/60));cameraLastUpdate=now;
1316:   const sep=currentCombatRange(),maxY=Math.max(aure.position.y,earth.position.y),minY=Math.min(aure.position.y,earth.position.y),midX=(aure.position.x+earth.position.x)/2,midY=(maxY+minY)/2;
1317:   const tactical=tacticalAimView||aiming,rangeExtra=Math.max(0,Math.min(82,(sep-55)*.92)),altExtra=Math.max(0,(maxY-18)*.72);
1318:   // PATCH 2 SAFE FRAME: size the view from the actual combat span, not a capped chase offset.
1319:   // This guarantees both vessel centers plus a hull safety margin remain inside the 16:9 frustum, even at X ±105.
1320:   const vHalf=THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(camera.fov*.5),hHalf=Math.atan(Math.tan(vHalf)*camera.aspect);
1321:   const horizontalNeed=(sep*.5+29)/Math.max(.18,Math.tan(hHalf));
1322:   const verticalNeed=((maxY-minY)*.5+17)/Math.max(.18,Math.tan(vHalf));
1323:   const baseZ=(tactical?92:82)+rangeExtra+altExtra*.72;
1324:   const safeZ=Math.max(baseZ,horizontalNeed,verticalNeed);
1325:   // Center the camera on the actual midpoint. Scaling midX toward zero was the source of edge loss at extreme retreat.
1326:   let desiredPos,desiredLook,desiredZoom=1;
1327:   if(xrayOpen){
1328:     // X-Ray is a tactical character-selection view. Focus the local vessel and keep its complete hull
1329:     // inside the frame instead of barely magnifying the full two-vessel battlefield.
1330:     const xrayCenter=localXrayRooms().getWorldPosition(new THREE.Vector3());
1331:     desiredPos=new THREE.Vector3(xrayCenter.x,xrayCenter.y+2.8,xrayCenter.z+46);
1332:     desiredLook=new THREE.Vector3(xrayCenter.x,xrayCenter.y,xrayCenter.z);
1333:     desiredZoom=1.14;
1334:   }else{
